method: Use actual exported meshes. Source ceiling read from the generated field. From outside each side, the first two distinct ray intersections define the material chord. All original face, ear and mechanical geometry remains in the test.
limitations: X chord is directional wall thickness, not the global minimum normal wall thickness.
Source-plane continuation is a design reference, not an official posterior skull.
Residuals near ear/feature locks or seam protection may be intentional but remain visible shape tradeoffs.
This does not replace full topology, cap collision, eye insertion or physical printing checks.
